notes:
Summary: mid-market retail analytics vendor evaluating Redwood to replace existing vector stack (self-hosted + ML infra). Primary focus: embeddings + reranker migration to improve relevance for product search and FAQ support.

Key constraints / asks (from AE/SE calls):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end query < 400ms for 1-2k QPS spiky workloads. Can accept slightly higher p99 if routed to lower-cost path.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to reduce cost/query vs current GPU-hosted reranker by ~30% while preserving quality.
- Quality bar: "won't accept >1% drop in NDCG@10 or MRR for top queries" — marketing/product teams are strict. Evals-driven decision required.
- Indexing: current corpus ~20M product+support docs; expect growth to ~80M. Need efficient shard/batching and incremental reindexing.
- Security: VPC + SSO + audit logs mandatory; would prefer KMS integration for key control.

Desired Redwood capabilities called out: automatic canary/A-B rollout for reranker models, per-route latency/cost dashboards, quantization and batching recommendations from Optimize, built-in evals to compare embedding+reranker combos. SE asked about prefix caching and KV cache behavior for chat-like product Q&A.

Quote from Head of Search (call 2026-03-01): "We need a rollback plan if quality slips — our conversion hits are at stake."

POC ask: full eval harness run comparing current SBERT+LightGBM reranker vs new open embedding model + learned cross-encoder reranker on 50k holdout queries. Success metrics: NDCG, latency P95, cost/query.

Notes on procurement: procurement wants a 3-month dedicated POC with committed capacity pricing. Legal flagged data residency for EU customers (future requirement).
